jules: heads-up — saw a customer report where the console shows org quota being charged even though the request used a project-scoped SA token. seems like our proxy resolution is resolving to org when both exist.
matt: can you paste an example request/headers? curious if this is the proxy or the billing attribution layer
jules: here's a redacted example:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sa-token-xxxx (project:proj-42, org:org-99)
X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4
X-Auth-Proxy: delegated/sa:proj-42
```
console showed org:org-99 as the payer and the project quota left unchanged.
nina: hmm we intentionally fall back to org in some routing policies. the ambiguity is when the token includes both project and org claims. proxy currently strips project claim in header-to-identity mapping.
liz: that sounds like a bug in the proxy's claim canonicalizer. I remember a change last quarter that normalized to the highest-level principal for rate-limiting.
cheng: right — there was an older invariant: one effective-principal per request. but we added delegation which introduced (origin_project, delegate_org) tuples and we never updated the console display rules.
matt: what does telemetry show? are we emitting the effective_identity used for quota calc?
jules: currently we emit `quota_owner` = org-99 in billing events. there's an `auth.debug` log with the claim set but not surfaced to metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.12-2134: auth-proxy v3.8 rolled to canary cluster A ✅
nina: proposal: add `effective_identity` and `identity_chain` fields in the request context that are written to both trace/span and the quota event. UI can then show "effective identity (calc)" and an expandable chain.
liz: UI idea: prefix the usage row with a small tooltip/breadcrumb: Project > ServiceAccount (delegate) > Org
cheng: also need a deterministic tie-breaker for quota ownership: explicit project claim wins, then delegated project, then org fallback. document this in the routing policy.
matt: agree. we should also add a short-lived flag to flip behaviour for existing tenants (alpha on by default for new tenants, opt-in for old ones) to avoid billing surprises.
jules: I'll sketch the patch. backend changes:
- proxy: stop stripping project claim; populate `identity_chain` = [origin, delegated, org]
- quota service: prefer first project in chain, fallback to org
- telemetry: emit `auth.resolve` event with `chain`, `chosen_owner`, `resolution_reason`
- console: fetch `chosen_owner` from usage events and show tooltip for chain
nina: telemetry schema:
```
event: auth.resolve
attrs:
  chain: "[\"proj:proj-42\", \"sa:sa-7\", \"org:org-99\"]"
  chosen_owner: "proj:proj-42"
  reason: "explicit_claim"
```
liz: small UX ask — when chosen_owner differs from token top-level claim we should show a warning banner: "Usage will be charged to X due to routing policy" with a link to docs.
matt: QA checklist: add unit tests for proxy normalization, integration test for billing pipeline, e2e with console displaying chain
cheng: rollout plan: canary on non-billing clusters -> metric check for unexpected owner flips -> 48h -> gradual roll to billing clusters. add a migration mode that keeps legacy behavior and tags events with `legacy_routing=true`.
jules: will also add a migration job to backfill `identity_chain` for recent traces so customers can reconcile prior invoices if needed
nina: one more thing: rate limits. if project wins for quota but org has an override SLO we need to handle limit merging. propose we compute both project_limit and org_limit and apply the stricter token-level rate limiter, but surface both limits in telemetry.
liz: agreed. console should show both limits when they differ.
matt: ok action items:
- jules: PR to proxy + quota service (estimating 2d)
- nina: telemetry schema + event producer (1d)
- liz: small console UI patch + tooltip copy (1d)
- cheng: rollout plan + feature flag (0.5d)
I'll put tasks in the eng-platform board.
jules: thanks. I'm going to start the proxy PR and include a minimal `identity_chain` header: `X-Identity-Chain: proj:proj-42,sa:sa-7,org:org-99`
nina: prefer using structured trace fields instead of ad-hoc header but header is fine as fallback for downstream services.
liz: thumbs up. let's sync after the PR is up.
matt: noted — add a short note to docs: /docs/platform/auth-routing.md about tie-breaker and UI semantics
jules: filing follow-up thread for docs and migration reconciliation.
deploy-bot: ticket ENG-3812 created: auth.resolve telemetry + console chain UI
cheng: thanks all :thumbsup:
